messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: error with as.ddmatrix in pbdDMAT 0.4-0
parts:
So this wasn't happening an earlier version of pbdDMAT (I think I was
using 0.2-3 most recently before upgrading).

Calls to as.ddmatrix (including just running the example code from
help(as.ddmatrix)) are giving this:

===============================
Using 2x1 for the default grid size

Error in base.rpdgemr2d(x = dx@Data, descx = descx, descy = descy) :
object 'ret' not found
Calls: as.ddmatrix ... .local -> distribute -> dmat.reblock -> base.rpdgemr2d
Execution halted

===============================

This is on Ubuntu 14.04 with current pbdDMAT and dependencies
installed off CRAN. Also occurs on Scientific Linux 6.6.

fixed on github, but we're waiting out the clock to not violate the "1-2
month" CRAN policy on updates.

Thanks
-Drew
